{{Recipe summary
| Category = Cake recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

This '''strawberry shortcut cake''' is one of those recipes from the 1970s with lots of already-processed ingredients. It's very moist because the syrupy strawberry mixture starts on top and soaks through as the cake bakes.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] mini [[Cookbook:Marshmallow|marshmallows]]
* 2 cups (20 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) frozen, sliced [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]] in syrup, completely thawed
* 1 pkg (3 oz) strawberry [[Cookbook:Jello|jello]] powder (known as ''jelly'' outside of North America)
* 2¼ cups [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1½ cups white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]

==Procedure==
#Generously grease the bottom of a 13x9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake pan]]. 
#Sprinkle marshmallows evenly over bottom of pan.
#Thoroughly combine completely thawed strawberries and syrup with dry jello; set aside. 
#In a large mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Mix at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at medium speed, scraping sides of bowl occasionally.
#Pour batter over marshmallows, and spread out. Spoon strawberry mixture evenly over batter.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350°F for 45–60 minutes or until golden brown and a [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]] inserted in center comes out clean.
#Serve warm or cool with [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]] or [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]].

steps.text: Generously grease the bottom of a 13x9-inch cake pan.
Sprinkle marshmallows evenly over bottom of pan.
Thoroughly combine completely thawed strawberries and syrup with dry jello; set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Mix at low speed until moistened; beat 3 minutes at medium speed, scraping sides of bowl occasionally.
Pour batter over marshmallows, and spread out. Spoon strawberry mixture evenly over batter.
Bake at 350°F for 45–60 minutes or until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Serve warm or cool with ice cream or whipped cream.
